description: Source code for the FrameCaptureLayer class in Android's media stagefright framework, handling buffer capture, conversion, and management for video frames.

classes.name: FrameCaptureLayer::BufferLayer
classes.description: Represents a buffer layer used in frame capturing, providing layer settings based on buffer item properties.

methods.name: translateDataspace
methods.description: Converts legacy dataspace enums to modern dataspace enums.

methods.name: FrameCaptureLayer::BufferLayer::getLayerSettings
methods.description: Populates layer settings for rendering based on buffer item properties.

methods.name: FrameCaptureLayer::init
methods.description: Initializes the FrameCaptureLayer, setting up buffer queue and surface.

methods.name: FrameCaptureLayer::capture
methods.description: Captures a frame into a graphic buffer with specified pixel format and crop.

methods.name: FrameCaptureLayer::onFrameAvailable
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new frame is available.

methods.description: Acquires a buffer from the buffer queue, waiting if necessary.

methods.description: Releases a buffer back to the buffer queue.
